title: Where would you like to use EasyPaper?
preserved: Local data is kept until you explicitly confirm a synchronization action. Remote mode opens the server library; local mode opens this computer’s library.
urlHelp: Enter the address you use to open EasyPaper in your browser. Sign in with your server account after connecting.
failed: Could not connect. Check the server address and try again.
download: Download server data to this computer
downloadHelp: Copies your server documents, originals, translations, notes and reading data into your local library. Local documents and settings are preserved. Each download adds a new copy; this is not automatic synchronization.
confirmDownload: Download your server library as new local copies? Repeating this action creates additional copies. Keep EasyPaper open until it finishes.
downloading: Downloading server backup: {{size}} MiB… Keep EasyPaper open.
importing: Adding documents to the local library… Keep EasyPaper open.
completed: Added {{count}} documents to your local library. Turn off the remote connection to use them locally.
connectionError: Could not load connection settings. Retry before opening your library.
localSettings: Manage local / remote mode and download server data.
replaceLocal: Delete local data — use the server library
replaceRemote: Delete server data — use the local library
actionHelp: Saving this choice does not delete data. After signing in, preview and confirm the synchronization. Account credentials and AI settings stay on each device.
automatic: Automatically merge every 5 minutes while the app is open and all document tabs are closed
syncHelp: Sync saved documents, originals, translations, notes and reading records in both directions without adding duplicate copies. Concurrent edits stop for your decision. Both the app and server must support synchronization.
previewCounts: Local library: {{local}} documents · Server library: {{remote}} documents
confirmReplaceLocal: Delete the existing local library and replace it with the server library, including notes and history. The server library is kept. This requires your confirmation.
confirmReplaceRemote: Delete the existing server library and replace it with this computer’s library, including notes and history. This affects the signed-in server account. This requires your confirmation.
confirmMerge: Combine both libraries. After the first synchronization, edits and deletions are reflected in both directions. Conflicting changes will not be overwritten automatically.
syncUploading: Sending local changes to the server… Keep EasyPaper open.
syncCompleted: Two-way synchronization completed. Local library: {{count}} documents. Reload to see the latest data.
syncConflict: Changes conflict. Automatic overwriting has stopped. Review both libraries, then retry or explicitly select which side should replace the other.
syncCancelled: Synchronization was not started. Both libraries are unchanged.
syncResume: An interrupted operation is waiting. Confirm to resume the same transfer without duplicates.
saveAddressFirst: Save and open the new server address before synchronizing.
localHint: Your library stays on this device.
remoteHint: Open your library on an EasyPaper server.
deferHelp: Keep both libraries as they are. You can choose how to sync later.
acknowledgeDeletion: I understand that the selected library, including its notes and history, will be replaced.
conflictsHelp: Review these items in both libraries and retry. To keep only one library, select which side to replace above, then review and confirm. Replacing a library also removes its other data.
conflictCheckpoint: Sync history changed; review the pending transfer
conflictConfirmation: Data changed after your preview; review again
deviceDetails: {{online}} · Status: {{status}} · Policy: {{action}} · Automatic sync: {{automatic}} · Last seen: {{seen}}
deviceHelp: Change connection settings in the desktop app. Confirm the synchronization preview in the app after requesting sync.
